name: visual-fidelity-index
description: Open, vendor-neutral display sharpness standard. Measures pixels per degree of visual angle normalised to the human acuity limit.

scripts.build: cat assets/css/tokens.css assets/css/base.css assets/css/navbar.css assets/css/hero.css assets/css/calculator.css assets/css/comparator.css assets/css/database.css assets/css/science.css assets/css/footer.css assets/css/components.css > assets/css/styles.css && npx esbuild assets/js/main.js --bundle --outfile=assets/js/bundle.js --format=iife && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r index.html assets _headers docs dist/ && cp assets/favicon.svg dist/favicon.svg 2>/dev/null; true
